note: UNVERIFIED. Hand-written from the AWS ExpiredTokenException shape. Bedrock credentials are STS session tokens that expire on a timer, so this is the auth_failure most likely to be seen in production - and D7 keeps it out of the breaker precisely because an expired token of ours says nothing about AWS's health.

kwargs.message: BedrockException - {"__type":"ExpiredTokenException","message":"The security token included in the request is expired."}
